original_chart.lagrangian_constraint_sector: L contains + z^T (Mx x + Mv xdot) + (1/2) z^T C z; stationary z = -C^{-1}(Mx x + Mv xdot)

scientific_boundary: A PASS exports free-sector K, C and the exact linear decomposition of the constraint source in one original chart, and the transformed free kinetic metric in the physical chart. It does not supply matter covectors d,h, does not erase velocity mixing, does not compute V or K_Q, and does not authorize MAT, UVIR or downstream physics claims.
